It is my intention that that one be Henry.”", "sha256": "6d0c85a0aa461636b6b93f8bc874c3218d265503110151d250fdde6f03661252", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1354]", "source_html": "

“Perhaps you have not understood,” she chided gravely. “I intend to marry Henry. I love you. I love Henry. But I cannot marry both of you. The law will not permit. Therefore I shall marry only one of you. It is my intention that that one be Henry.”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u017-r0023", "tag": "p", "text": "“Then why, why,” he demanded, “did you persuade me into remaining?”", "sha256": "08c2f598686136141e08e1dd61cfd0770d88443e8c7e1f9067e3fb595e24ae3e", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1355]", "source_html": "

“If you keep this up I shall go mad!” he cried.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u017-r0026", "tag": "p", "text": "“I have felt like going mad over it myself many times,” she assured him. “If you think it is easy for me thus to play the Anglo-Saxon, you are mistaken.
